memberdef.name: DECLARE_VERBOSITY_PARAM
memberdef.initializer: (prm).declare_entry("verbosity", \ std::string(default_verbosity), \ Patterns::Selection("quiet|verbose"), \ "Level of message display in console: quiet or verbose " \ "(default: " + \ std::string(default_verbosity) + ")");

memberdef.name: READ_VERBOSITY_PARAM
memberdef.initializer: { \ const std::string parsed_verbosity = (prm).get("verbosity"); \ if (parsed_verbosity == "quiet") \ verbosity = Verbosity::quiet; \ if (parsed_verbosity == "verbose") \ verbosity = Verbosity::verbose; \ }
